topMismatches.problem: No group relationship or shared action
topMismatches.requiredCorrection: Use or build one cohesive hero composition containing a primary character, an opposing/secondary force, arena/audience context and one shared action effect. Do not reconstruct it from unrelated foreground stickers.

topMismatches.problem: No shared light or material world
topMismatches.requiredCorrection: Choose a hero source whose subjects and environment are rendered together, or perform a deliberate compositing pass with matched key light, rim light, shadows, haze, edge treatment and black levels.

topMismatches.problem: Hero story and next module compete
topMismatches.requiredCorrection: Let the hero own spectacle. Make the following deck module quieter and task-oriented, or visually connect it as a continuation instead of staging another equal-weight VS moment.
